messages:
alex: quick q — we need to decide precedence for auto-swap during canaries. current options: model-variant first, region failover second, capacity degrade last. thoughts?
maria: prefer model-variant first. switching to a quantized variant is cheap and keeps latency stable. also preserves region affinity for data residency.
noah: agree on variant-first but what about safety nets for perf regressions? if variant increases 95th p50 latency we should failover region instead of reverting model.
tara: do we have a metric for "quality drop" to avoid swapping purely on latency? some prompts are sensitive.
sam: we do — quality_regression_pct from eval harness. threshold currently 2.5% failing prompts. can tie that into the policy.
alex: sketching a policy idea: prefer variants for cost/latency wins, but require quality_regression_pct <= 1% in last 5m to auto-swap. otherwise, try regional failover if region has spare capacity. full rollback only after both fail.
maria: that sounds sensible. also add a cooldown: don't auto-swap model more than once every 10m for a rollout to avoid flip-flopping.
noah: +1. and we should expose a circuit-breaker window: error_rate > 1.5% for 2m triggers immediate rollback to previous stable variant.
sam: putting a quick draft JSON config we can use in console (WIP):
```json
{"strategy":"auto-safety-net","steps":[{"type":"variant_swap","quality_threshold":0.01,"latency_threshold_ms":200,"cooldown_s":600},{"type":"region_failover","min_spare_capacity_pct":15},{"type":"capacity_degrade","fallback_model":"small-quant","max_qps":50}],"circuit_breaker":{"error_rate_pct":1.5,"window_s":120}}
```

tara: love the explicit steps. small comment: min_spare_capacity_pct=15 feels high for bursty traffic. can we use a dynamic check of pod headroom instead?
alex: yes — change that to a policy expression -> "min_spare_capacity_pct || headroom_qps>10". console will need a simple UX for people who just choose presets vs advanced expressions.
noah: UX note: show a visible lineage when we auto-swap — e.g., "canary v2 -> variant quantized v2 -> region eu-west-1" so operators can trace what happened.
maria: agree. also log the eval prompt sample that triggered quality concern (anonymized) so SREs and ML can reproduce.
sam: deploy-bot: canary 2024-04-xx started for model v2 on prod-us. monitoring hooks enabled. :rocket:
alex: cool — once we have the policy merged I'll wire the console toggle (Auto-safety-net ON/OFF) and add a small help tooltip about precedence.
tara: one implementation question: should fallback be synchronous in the request path (block request while we swap) or async (serve degraded until swap completes)? i favor async with a temporary routing layer to avoid blocking.
maria: async. degrade gracefully: route new traffic to stable instances while swap finishes; send a non-blocking requeue for long requests.
sam: operationally we must ensure retries don't amplify load during a region failover. add a backoff knob in the policy.
alex: noted — add "max_retry_spill": 20% to policy draft. I'll update the PR and tag ML + SRE for review.
noah: final ask: add an audit event for every auto-swap decision with reason code (latency, quality, capacity) so billing + incident timelines can reconcile.
alex: will do. tagging: @maria @sam @tara for final signoff.
deploy-bot: canary health: p50=120ms, p95=430ms, error_rate=0.4%, quality_regression=0.6% — monitoring continues.
maria: thanks. will watch the quality dashboard and flag if it drifts.
